exec_summary.headline: Governed runtimes are the decision surface
exec_summary.body: The strongest cross-source signal is that agents become usable when identity, tool boundaries, traceability, recovery, and human review are designed into the runtime.

exec_summary.headline: Model choice now carries operating constraints
exec_summary.body: Open and hosted options widen the test surface, but licensing, residency, memory, latency, and blended task cost need to be evaluated together.

exec_summary.headline: Evaluation and adoption are becoming operational
exec_summary.body: Trajectory-level measures and explicit workforce decision boundaries are the bridge from compelling demos to bounded enterprise experiments.
